_doc: Athanor runtime configuration template — copied verbatim by /athanor:setup. _doc fields act as inline schema; root athanor.json (dev) and templates/athanor.json (user-install) stay shape-identical. To customize, edit your project root athanor.json after setup creates it.

codex._doc: Cross-model planning via Codex CLI. enabled=true makes /athanor:plan deep tier dispatch a Codex Planner B in parallel with Claude Planner A. fallback strategy when codex CLI is unavailable: 'self-critic' (Claude self-reviews) | 'skip' (single-planner only) | 'fail' (abort). See skills/plan/SKILL.md §Step 0 codex_available probe.

ralphLoop._doc: Max ralph-loop iterations per subtask before circuit breaker engages. Each iteration re-runs the executor with the same subtask plus latest verify output. Increase for fragile verify commands; decrease for fast-fail policy.

circuitBreaker._doc: After N consecutive subtask failures, leader pauses and asks user: action options are 'ask_user' (default), 'continue' (next subtask), 'abort' (stop pipeline).

team._doc: /athanor:work --team mode. waveSize is max parallel workers per wave (limited by Claude Code concurrent Task slots). discoveryRelay=true injects previous wave discoveries into next wave's worker prompts.

memory._doc: Lessons lifecycle in .athanor/lessons/. Working lessons decay after decayDays unless they reach promotionThreshold reads (then auto-promoted to permanent). Sessions older than maxAgeDays are cleaned by the cleaner agent (permanent lessons preserved).

models._doc: Model assignment per worker role. Effort levels: opus=highest reasoning (planning, critique, execution, review), sonnet=standard (research, analysis, learning), haiku=minimal (cleanup). User installs may swap (e.g., executor: 'sonnet' for cost optimization). Skills read this config in their dispatch templates.

triggers._doc: Slash-command trigger language: 'ko' (Korean only), 'en' (English only), 'both' (default — both Korean and English keywords trigger skills). See each skill's frontmatter description for trigger keyword lists.

hooks._doc: Stop hook profile: 'off' (skip verification gate entirely — for analysis-only or trusted-pipeline sessions), 'lenient' (only invoke on explicit success claims like 'tests pass'), 'standard' (default — material-claim trigger as defined in hooks/hooks.json), 'strict' (invoke on any work-state assertion). disabled[] is a list of hook ids to skip individually (currently only Stop hook ships, but future PostToolUse/PreCompact hooks will respect this list). Honored by hook prompts via ATHANOR_HOOK_PROFILE / ATHANOR_DISABLED_HOOKS environment variables (set by Claude Code from this config).

review._doc: /athanor:review skill default lenses dispatched in parallel (file-type filtering may narrow this). minConfidence (0-100 anchored rubric) suppresses findings below threshold during consolidation; raise to reduce noise, lower to surface speculative concerns. See agents/reviewer.md §Confidence Rubric.
